description: This file implements the AWCContainerAdministrator class, including its constructor, destructor, and the Container method, as well as the PluginConfig class for configuration parsing. It manages container instances, interacts with external AWCClient, and handles container creation logic.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for parsing container settings from a JSON string, including proxy usage and timeouts.

classes.name: AWCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages AWC containers, handles their creation, and maintains a singleton instance.

methods.name: PluginConfig::PluginConfig
methods.description: Constructor that parses configuration string and sets proxy usage and timeouts.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::AWCContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container administrator and sets up the AWC client listener.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::~AWCContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Destructor that removes the AWC client listener if present.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on the name and configuration, supporting proxy or direct container types.

methods.name: IContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the container administrator.
